map.alt: Map of Razorfen Kraul in WoW Forever, with where each boss stands

abilities.name: Summon Boar Spirit
abilities.description: Calls a Boar Spirit to fight beside him every 30 to 45 seconds (1.5-second cast). Kill each one before the next comes.

abilities.name: Chain Heal
abilities.description: Below 75% health he heals himself, and the heal jumps to two allies near him (2.5-second cast). Interrupt it.

abilities.name: Dominate Mind
abilities.description: Takes control of a player other than his target for 15 seconds (2-second cast). Interrupt it, or dispel it from the player.

abilities.name: Shadow Bolt
abilities.description: He keeps his distance to cast it. Interrupt it.

abilities.name: Summon Earth Rumbler
abilities.description: A Stone Rumbler stands with him and fights at his side.

abilities.name: Lightning Bolt
abilities.description: He keeps his distance to cast it. Interrupt it.

abilities.name: Calls for help
abilities.description: When pulled, he calls the creatures within 15 yards to join him, the two Razorfen Spearhides at his side among them. Crowd-control one of them.

abilities.name: Thunderclap
abilities.description: Every 8 to 14 seconds: Nature damage to everyone near him, and their attacks and movement are slowed for 10 seconds.

abilities.name: Thorns Aura
abilities.description: Whoever strikes him or an ally near him, Overlord Ramtusk included, takes Nature damage.

trigger.text: A ward closes his cave. Kill the two Death's Head Ward Keepers standing in front of it: the ward goes down when both are dead.

abilities.name: Left for Dead
abilities.description: Every 21 to 35 seconds he strikes a player other than his target, who falls as if dead and can neither attack nor cast. Moving ends it.

abilities.name: Rampage
abilities.description: Every 25 to 31 seconds: hits everyone near him and stuns them for 2.5 seconds.

abilities.name: Enrage
abilities.description: At 60% health, and again at 40%, he attacks 60% faster and hits harder for 2 minutes.

trigger.text: A rare bat, not there on every run. When it is, it waits in a small recess in the wall of the bat cave near Charlga Razorflank.

abilities.name: Chain Bolt
abilities.description: She keeps her distance and casts it again and again: lightning that jumps to up to 3 players (2.5-second cast). Interrupt it.

abilities.name: Purity
abilities.description: Every 9 to 15 seconds she is immune to all attacks and spells for 2 seconds.

abilities.name: Renew
abilities.description: Heals a wounded ally, or herself, over 15 seconds. A priest or a shaman can remove it.

abilities.name: Summon Earth Rumbler
abilities.description: A Stone Rumbler stands with him and fights at his side.

abilities.name: Lightning Bolt
abilities.description: He keeps his distance to cast it. Interrupt it.

abilities.name: Runs for help
abilities.description: At 15% health he runs off to bring help. Finish him before he gets away.
